column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

RE-POINTED AT THE OFFLINE REFEREE.  THE x86_64 STATIC-DECODE LEG drove build/contrib/plugins/isaxcheck, a binary that linked Capstone into the build and was deleted with it, so this row had NO PRODUCER at the tip and read REPORT MISSING -- a red about the apparatus and not about the trace.  Per the standing external-comparison ruling the reference now runs OFFLINE over recorded encodings, and the row is re-pointed at the successor rather than retired: cst_referee.py decodes the recorded encodings offline and gapreport.py joins its opcode word against QEMU's, one bucket per encoding, with every disagreement class arbitrated in gapreport_rulings.tsv. WHAT THIS ONE MEASURES: the same question -- does the trace drop what a reference states, and is every difference understood -- over the encodings the guest actually ran.  The headline is UNRULED encodings (the difference nobody has read) PLUS COVERAGE-PATH encodings (read, and the reference won: the wire owes a change).  Arbitrated-to-QEMU encodings are outside it, exactly as TRACER-SUPERSET was.  CEILING 3, DERIVED FROM THIS READING AND NOT SET TO IT: UNRULED is 0 and the 3 are the coverage-path encodings, each with a written per-row arbitration -- `fild m32int` (the reference's FP_CVT keeps the conversion the wire's LOAD drops), `ud2` (the reference names the trap this encoding IS, the wire names nothing), and `xgetbv` (the reference's NOP is false and the verdict went to QEMU, but the 0F 01 group still owes a word one level down).  NO MARGIN: a headline of 4 is a finding to open.  FLOOR 95000 against 105,762 encodings joined with the reference at this tip.  THE STALE FIXTURE IS GONE WITH THE ROW: the selftest default carried 47 against a ceiling of 11 because the banked root predates exec179's re-derivation; the successor report is regenerated at the tip as part of this re-point and the fixture moves with it per #305. exec244 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip). HEADLINE 57 (35 TRACER-SUBSET + 22 UNACCOUNTED) over 1,002 facts / 210 distinct encodings, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 22.  The 22 UNACCOUNTED are enumerated and split three ways.  (1) NINE ROWS ARE A REAL TRACER LOSS AND THE CEILING WILL NOT COVER THEM -- FINDING 244-C.  Eight on p_simd: ld2/ld3/ld4 at 0x4000ec/f0/f4 and add/addv/umov/ins/dup at 0x400124/128/12c/130/134, every one ref={REG_VECn...} against trc={} -- the wire names NO destination at all.  The ninth is p_hint 0x4000e8 `msr tpidr_el0,x3`, ref={REG_TLS} trc={}.  Witnessed on the wire and not only in the comparator: cst_decode --format=legacy over p_simd.cst prints `0x4000ec: op=GEN_OP_VEC_LOAD src=[] dst=[]` and the same empty pair on GEN_OP_VEC_ADD and GEN_OP_VEC_MOV.  IT IS NOT THIS WAVE'S: the identical eight rows with identical {} sit in exec242/legs/r13/_work/gem5cp_aarch64/final/rows.tsv.  AND IT IS CONFINED: the neighbouring contiguous ld1 forms at 0x4000dc/e4 and 0x400110/114 DO publish and score REF-NEON-PAIRWISE-DEST, so the gap is the de-interleaving loads and the SIMD ALU/move forms, not NEON as a whole.  (2) NINE ROWS, dc cvau/civac/cvac at 0x4000bc/c0/c4, memop-count/addr/width, ref (0,1)@64B against trc (0,0): gem5 models a cache-maintenance op as a 64-byte data access and QEMU performs none.  The leg already carries the named rule REF-READS-MACHINE-STATE for this family on its WP side and does not apply it here.  (3) THREE ROWS, dc zva at 0x4000cc, TRACER-SUPERSET: trc 32 accesses / 512 bytes against ref 1 / 64.  Both describe the same zeroing; the split differs, which is the already-named SAME-BYTES-DIFFERENT-SPLIT class.  Plus one ORTHOGONAL row, `msr ic_ivau_xt,x21`, ref={MISC:ic_ivau_xt} -- a gem5 misc register with no architectural counterpart -- against trc={REG_PC}.  Prior adjudication, unchanged and still the source of the per-row work: R13_VERDICT.md 4.1 -- 5 REF-NEON-PAIRWISE-DEST, 3 IMPLDEF-MACHINE-VALUE, 6 memop-extent, 3 PREFETCH-SIZE, 2 FPSR-GRANULARITY, 3 SAME-BYTES-DIFFERENT-SPLIT

exec244 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip). HEADLINE 379 = 214 WP-DEFECT + 165 UNACCOUNTED over 40,798 facts / 125 encodings, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 0.  Every row is named and 295 of the 379 are APPARATUS DEBT WHOSE RULE IS ALREADY WRITTEN ELSEWHERE IN THIS SAME LEG -- FINDING 244-E.  (1) 165 UNACCOUNTED, 94 reg-dst-set + 71 reg-src-set, EVERY ONE only_trc={REG_PC} and only_ref empty: a pure superset, the identical class the correct-path mipsel leg retired at this same tip once its reference-mapper rule was written.  aarch64's WP comparator has not had that rule ported.  That is 44% of this headline and it is not a wire loss.  (2) 130 WP-DEFECT sys-src-set on p_wpmem, 100 with only_ref={REG_FLAGS,REG_SYSFPEN} and 30 with only_ref={REG_FCSR,REG_FLAGS,REG_SYSFPEN}.  REG_SYSFPEN is CPACR_EL1.FPEN, which gem5 reads as a SOURCE of every FP/SIMD micro-op because it models the FP-enable trap check as an operand read; an enable gate is not a datum.  This leg ALREADY names GEM5-LIMIT REF-READS-MACHINE-STATE for exactly that on 18 p_wpcache sys-src rows and does not apply it to p_wpmem.  (3) 48 rows on p_wpcache `dc zva`: 12 reg-src only_ref={REG_GPR21} plus 12 each of memop-count/addr/width, where the reference names 64 single-byte stores S:0x410540..0x41057f and the wire publishes a different split of the same 64 bytes -- SAME-BYTES-DIFFERENT-SPLIT once more.  (4) 36 fpsr-dst-set WP-DEFECT: 30 only_ref={REG_FCSR} and 6 only_ref={MISC:ic_ivau_xt}, the same gem5 misc register the correct-path leg carries.  NOTHING HERE IS A NEW WIRE CLASS and no ceiling is earned by apparatus debt.  Prior adjudication, unchanged: R13_VERDICT.md 5.1 -- 15/15 axis mutations FIRED, 8/8 cache-maintenance rules REFUSED

exec244 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip). HEADLINE 257 -> 105 = 20 WP-DEFECT + 85 UNACCOUNTED over 5,553 facts / 109 encodings, 42 excursions, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 0.  THE TWO CLASSES THE x87 LANDING MINTED ARE RULED HERE ON WRITTEN MERITS, AND BOTH ARE TRACER-RIGHT.  (A) 60 UNACCOUNTED reg-dst-set rows, twelve x87 PCs (0x40101d..0x401045) x 5 excursions, only_trc={REG_SYS}.  regmap/x86_64.tsv maps fpip/fpcs/fpdp/fpds to REG_SYS with its own written reason -- "x87 exception pointer: machine state saved for a handler, not a value the program computes with" -- and every non-control x87 instruction updates the last-instruction and last-data pointers, so the wire is stating a real destination.  The reference CANNOT speak: this leg's own report prints "unmappable-id:REG_SYS 42", i.e. gem5's x86 vocabulary has no index that produces REG_SYS.  Reference gap with a checkable basis in the mapper, the same shape as the REG_PC class, and the rule is derivable and NOT YET WRITTEN.  (B) 15 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set rows at 0x401025/27/2d x 5, only_trc={REG_FCSR} against ref {REG_FPR0,REG_FPR1}.  Under the composed-register contract settled at 050283a3f1 a folded FIELD publishes its CONTAINER, so reading the rounding-control field of the x87 control word IS a read of REG_FCSR; ledger #277c asks this exact question and answers SOURCE.  Tracer right; the rule is written and not ported to this leg.  (C) THE BRIEF'S ARITHMETIC IS INCOMPLETE AND THE REMAINDER IS NOT SLACK.  60 + 15 = 75, and the headline is 105.  Ten rows at 0x401041 and 0x401043 run the OTHER way: ref={REG_FCSR,REG_FPR0} against trc={REG_FPR0,REG_SYS} -- REG_FCSR is in the reference and NOT on the wire, so two x87 PCs do not publish their status-word write.  That is a LOSS, filed as FINDING 244-D.  (D) 20 WP-DEFECT reg-src-set: 15 on p_wprmw at 0x40104d/0x401062/0x401095 with only_ref={REG_FLAGS}, and 5 on p_wpsse 0x40102b with ref={REG_VEC2} against trc={} -- the x86 sibling of 244-C, a vector source not published at all.  (E) 10 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set on p_wpchain 0x40102a and p_wpflag 0x401047, only_ref={REG_FLAGS}.  So 75 rows are tracer-right and want rules, and 35 are real losses with two findings against them.  Prior adjudication, unchanged: exec33/flagsleak/EVIDENCE.md -- the leg EXISTS and RUNS; R13_VERDICT.md 5/8.1's "x86_64 has no wrong-path execution reference" is FALSE as written
